shots.p: wide shot of the first light of dawn breaking over a desert horizon, soft pink and gold sky, peaceful
wide shot of pilgrims in white garments walking toward Mecca's hills at night under a crescent moon, ten blessed nights
close-up of pairs and single objects: two dates beside one date, two pebbles beside one, arranged on a wooden tray in soft light
wide shot of night slowly moving across a desert, darkness flowing over dunes under a starry sky
close-up of a thoughtful wise man in a turban reflecting at dawn, his eyes calm and understanding
wide shot of ruined colossal stone columns half-buried in desert sand, a lost mighty civilization, harsh wind
low angle on enormous towering pillars of an ancient city of giants rising into a hazy sky, grand and imposing
aerial view of an unmatched ancient city with massive buildings and pillars, then dust storms swallowing it at the edges
wide shot of ancient houses carved deep into the rock face of a desert valley, like Mada'in Salih, golden light
wide shot of a vast army camp with countless tent pegs and banners spread along a Nile river bank, imposing power
wide shot of oppressed people bent under heavy labor while armed guards stand over them in a dusty ancient land
wide shot of a ruined city with broken walls and dried fields, scattered debris, corruption everywhere
wide shot of a fierce storm with lashing wind and hail pouring down suddenly on a proud ancient city, no people visible
low angle on a high watchtower on a lonely hilltop overlooking a road at dusk, sense of constant watchfulness
medium shot of a wealthy man in a fine robe in his lavish home surrounded by abundance, smiling proudly, warm light
medium shot of the same man now in a bare room with a near-empty sack of grain, looking dejected and complaining
medium shot of an orphan boy standing alone at a doorway, ignored by well-dressed men passing by
wide shot of a poor man with an empty bowl at a crowded feast while guests turn away without urging anyone to feed him
medium shot of a greedy man sweeping all coins of an inheritance toward himself across a table while relatives watch
close-up of a man clutching heaps of gold coins to his chest with obsessive love in dim lamplight
wide shot of the earth shaking violently, mountains crumbling and ground leveling into dust, no people
wide shot of a vast empty plain under an immense bright sky, row after row of dust and light lines stretching to the horizon, solemn awe, no figures
close-up on the face of a man filled with regret, tears in his eyes, a distant fiery glow on the horizon behind him
medium shot of the same man kneeling on dry ground, hands open, lamenting a wasted life, grey dawn
close-up of an old balance scale with one heavy dark pan sinking, stark solemn light, severe justice
close-up of heavy iron chains lying on dark stone, firmly bound, cold light, non-graphic
close-up on the serene peaceful face of an old man with closed eyes, gentle smile, soft morning light
wide shot of the same old man walking calmly along a path toward a bright sunrise, content and at peace
wide shot of a group of righteous people in white robes walking together in quiet harmony toward light
wide shot of a magnificent earthly garden with rivers, fruit trees and soft light at sunrise, deep peace
